title: Standard Monthly Options Expiration Week and Portfolio State

macro_program.name: external_market_event
macro_program.reason: The treatment is a public U.S. listed-derivatives expiration schedule that may transmit through index-market hedging and roll pressure; it is not a broker-safety or execution-recovery intervention.

research_height.transfer_path: public monthly derivatives-expiration week -> daily native signal and birth supply -> component lifecycle stressed-R and stop burden -> whole-portfolio calendar-conditioned risk or slot decision

central_question: Does the publicly scheduled Monday-through-Friday week containing the standard monthly third-Friday U.S. options expiration materially and broadly change the current portfolio's native opportunity supply, stressed lifecycle value or stop burden relative to other normal weeks?

lenses: mechanism: identify one previsible standard-expiration-week state from the official third-Friday convention without using price, volume, open interest or outcome-fitted thresholds
transmission: compare period-and-weekday-adjusted native signal count, durable-birth count and sub-three-signal-day incidence
portfolio result and falsification: compare component-period-centered stressed R and stop burden with both-book, period, component, weekday and contribution breadth
research_bundle.common_boundary: Only the six immutable CP2 event files, official expiration semantics and server dates are used. Treatment is known before every portfolio decision and no exact expiration-day, Thursday, Friday, quarterly or holiday subgroup can be selected.

frontier_selection.selection_reason: It is a direct US-index derivatives-market mechanism with a public causal schedule, dense four-period whole-portfolio coverage and an implementation consequence in calendar-conditioned risk or slot treatment. It does not require Live polling, a new signal invention or an incomplete binding counterfactual.

rejected_before_opening.reason: The Goal forbids polling Live research ledgers for context, replaying rows or synthesizing natural observations.
Unit 075 requires naturally complete future evidence and explicitly bars a CP2-only, retained-tail, report/deal or logger repair.
Participation, dispersion, rates, VIX, gold/yen, scheduled shock and CFTC positioning already have closed boundaries; another price or positioning transform would be adjacent without a new mechanism.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 085 established that 92.35 percent of the three-start shortfall is upstream of admission, while Units 050 and 072 preserve an asymmetric two-book economic relationship. Repeated continuous external states did not identify a treatment. A public derivatives-expiration mechanism can change supply, stop burden and shared risk without inventing an entry signal.
connection_bridge: The portfolio trades US30 and US100 books whose underlying index markets are directly exposed to listed-option hedging, rolling and settlement activity.
Unit 085's upstream supply gap makes a previsible state that changes native signal or birth incidence economically relevant to opportunity coverage rather than merely descriptive market context.
A broad favorable or adverse lifecycle result across both books would change whether one later bounded whole-portfolio calendar-conditioned risk-or-slot implementation question is worth opening.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_recent: Unit 089 used a delayed weekly regulatory positioning flow to diagnose relative US100-versus-US30 book value. Unit 090 uses a preannounced monthly derivatives-expiration calendar, all five weekdays, direct daily supply transmission and whole-portfolio lifecycle economics rather than trader positioning or a book-relative DID.
why_now.decision_if_favorable: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick question about bounded risk or slot expansion during the fixed standard-expiration week.
why_now.decision_if_adverse: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick question about bounded risk or slot reduction during the fixed standard-expiration week.
why_now.decision_if_no_field_ambiguous_or_invali: Preserve unconditional behavior, retain no options-expiration seed and rotate away.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_041_scheduled_us_macro_event_exposu: Unit 041 tested CPI, Employment and FOMC release exposure windows. Unit 090 uses no macro release, surprise or event-time position role; it tests a recurring listed-derivatives expiration week over all normal days.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_047_new_york_week_edge: Unit 047 compared Monday and Friday with Tuesday-through-Thursday. Unit 090 contains all five weekdays almost evenly, centers supply by period and weekday, and requires weekday breadth; it does not reopen a weekday or generic calendar edge.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_071_server_calendar_drift: Unit 071 decomposed overnight versus intraday index drift. Unit 090 uses no return-window decomposition or overnight sleeve and does not select a month subgroup from that result.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_085_native_signal_supply: Unit 085 identified a portfolio-wide upstream shortfall and consumed its sole independent-entry seed in Unit 086. Unit 090 does not invent an entry; it asks whether a previsible external-market structure changes the observed supply and value of the existing six components.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_089_cftc_relative_flow: Unit 089's complete CFTC relative-book strong null is preserved. Unit 090 uses no CFTC field, trader category, contract-position level, threshold, lag or component-sign rescue.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: No unconsumed causal entry seed remains; the proposed state conditions existing native supply and does not create a signal.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Selected because standard options expiration is a new public derivatives-market structure with complete causal scheduling, not another continuous price, rate, volatility or positioning transform.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Priority, reservation, occupancy, handoff and latency roles remain closed; the five-weekday treatment is not a clock permutation or weekday edge.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: No new held-position checkpoint exists and no exit threshold is opened.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Risk or slot is only a later decision consequence if both-book lifecycle evidence first establishes a broad direction; no current lot, slot or capital rule changes.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: A repeated closure census would not change a portfolio decision and is lower value than this new causal economic role.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and all heights. Do not automatically open an expiration day, quarterly expiration, end-of-month, holiday, weekday, options-volume, open-interest, gamma, risk, lot or slot variant.

treatment_and_causal_boundary.standard_expiration_week: For each calendar month, compute the calendar third Friday. Every normal SIZE_DAY server date from the preceding Monday through that Friday inclusive is STANDARD_EXPIRATION_WEEK.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.other_week: Every other normal SIZE_DAY server date is OTHER_WEEK.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.holiday_rule: The treatment is the calendar week, so a Friday exchange holiday or preceding-business-day expiration remains inside the same frozen Monday-through-Friday week. No holiday-specific adjustment or subgroup is made.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.availability: The third-Friday convention and annual calendars are public before every treated date. No same-day observation or future market value is needed.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.background_expirations: Daily, weekly, end-of-month and quarterly option expirations occur in the market but are neither excluded nor separately classified. They remain common background unless they fall naturally inside the fixed standard-expiration week.
treatment_and_causal_boundary.no_proxy_claim: This schedule is a treatment label, not direct measurement of dealer gamma, open interest, options volume, settlement flow or causal hedging inventory.

official_sources_to_freeze_after_declara.expected_statement: Monthly equity options expire on the third Friday of the expiration month.

premetric_structural_feasibility.scope: Only event type, exact component, server date, weekday and period were used. No final value_b, planned-risk division, stop reason, conditional lifecycle outcome, gate or verdict was calculated.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not a primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.normal_day: Exactly one SIZE_DAY server date within each fresh period. Keep every SIZE_DAY date, including days with zero SIGNAL_DECIDED or zero birth.
fixed_reconstruction.native_signal: Each SIGNAL_DECIDED event is one observed native passed opportunity. Count repeated same-day events separately and do not infer absent signals.
fixed_reconstruction.birth: OPEN for five market components and matched PASSIVE_FILL for Passive. No pending placement or expiry is a lifecycle start.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle: Pair each birth to the next same-component CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE under the authoritative strict alternation semantics. Parse positive planned risk from final detail; stressed R is final value_b divided by planned risk; EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop.
fixed_reconstruction.state: Classify the birth server date by the frozen standard-expiration-week rule. A lifecycle keeps its birth-date state through its final close.
fixed_reconstruction.supply_adjustment: For daily signal count, birth count and the indicator of fewer than three signals, subtract the full period-weekday cell mean before computing STANDARD_EXPIRATION_WEEK minus OTHER_WEEK.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle_centering: Within each of 24 component-period cells, subtract the full-cell mean stressed R and stop rate from every lifecycle before computing STANDARD_EXPIRATION_WEEK minus OTHER_WEEK.
fixed_reconstruction.causal_limit: The schedule is previsible, but the unit does not observe options positions, gamma or dealer inventory. Association with the scheduled week cannot name the hidden market intermediary.

fixed_reports.mechanism: Report the 49 third-Friday calendar months, treatment intervals, official semantic-source pins and exact state counts.
fixed_reports.transmission: Report raw and period-weekday-centered signal-rate, birth-rate and sub-three-signal-day differences pooled and by four periods.
fixed_reports.portfolio_result: Report raw and component-period-centered stressed-R and stop differences pooled, by both books, four periods, six components and five weekdays.
fixed_reports.contribution: Report absolute period, component and weekday contribution shares for the centered stressed-R contrast.
fixed_reports.limits: State that a schedule association is not direct evidence of options positioning, gamma, volume, open interest or a tradable intraday expiration signal.

requirements: All ten immutable input files retain exact byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes and all four closed boundaries retain their verdict authority.
All six official source snapshots and the deterministic schedule/receipt exist at their post-declaration committed hashes before outcomes open.

Reconstruct 16,477 distinct event rows, 1,051 unique SIZE_DAY dates, 2,429 SIGNAL_DECIDED events and 2,233 complete lifecycles with zero duplicate, overlap, pending, birth, close, planned-risk or period-end fault.
Reproduce exactly 243 treatment days, 580 treatment signals, 525 treatment births, 808 comparator days, 1,849 comparator signals and 1,708 comparator births.
Reproduce 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals, pooled stressed net 407.0477 USD and 24 finite component-period centering cells.
Both states exist in all four periods, both books and all six components; every treatment component-period cell has at least three births and every comparator component-period cell at least fifteen.
Treatment normal days include at least 45 of each weekday, preventing a weekday-edge restatement.
Pooled centered STANDARD_EXPIRATION_WEEK minus OTHER_WEEK stressed R is at least +0.10R.
Pooled centered stop-rate difference is at most -0.05.
The concordant favorable direction appears in both books, at least three of four periods, at least four of six components and at least three of five weekdays.
No one period contributes more than 60 percent, no one component more than 45 percent and no one weekday more than 45 percent of the absolute centered stressed-R numerator.
Pooled centered STANDARD_EXPIRATION_WEEK minus OTHER_WEEK stressed R is at most -0.10R.
Pooled centered stop-rate difference is at least +0.05.
The concordant adverse direction appears in both books, at least three of four periods, at least four of six components and at least three of five weekdays.
No one period contributes more than 60 percent, no one component more than 45 percent and no one weekday more than 45 percent of the absolute centered stressed-R numerator.
Absolute pooled centered stressed-R difference is less than 0.05R.
Absolute pooled centered stop-rate difference is less than 0.025.
Neither complete direction appears in more than two periods, more than three components or more than two weekdays.
Neither book pair is concordant in a complete favorable or adverse direction.

fixed_verdict_rules.favorable: PASS_STANDARD_OPTIONS_EXPIRATION_WEEK_FAVORABLE_STATE_RETAIN_ONE_RISK_SLOT_QUESTION when integrity and every favorable requirement pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.adverse: PASS_STANDARD_OPTIONS_EXPIRATION_WEEK_ADVERSE_STATE_RETAIN_ONE_RISK_SLOT_QUESTION when integrity and every adverse requirement pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_field: NO_MATERIAL_STANDARD_OPTIONS_EXPIRATION_WEEK_PORTFOLIO_FIELD when integrity passes and the complete strong-null rule triggers.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_STANDARD_OPTIONS_EXPIRATION_WEEK_STATE_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes and no preceding verdict applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_STANDARD_OPTIONS_EXPIRATION_SCHEDULE_OR_LIFECYCLE_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any source, schedule, event, lifecycle, coverage or density requirement fails.

decision_translation.directional_pass: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick bounded risk-or-slot treatment question in the selected direction. This exploratory unit authorizes no implementation.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Preserve unconditional behavior, retain no standard-expiration-week seed and rotate away.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away without same-family repair after budget exhaustion.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration, state, Lab index and single Frontier memory before persisting any official source snapshot or schedule CSV.
Commit and push all official snapshots, deterministic schedule CSV and acquisition receipt before reading any CP2 final value_b, planned risk, stop reason or state-conditioned lifecycle outcome.
One acquisition/serialization correction is allowed only before any supply or lifecycle result is emitted. After any result, make no correction or rerun.
Do not change the calendar week, comparator, centering, outcomes, thresholds, breadth, contribution caps, verdict or decision after results.
Do not create MQL, compile, run Tester, query broker/account/position/order/deal state, poll Live research ledgers, touch Live or open Program 6.
